label: Voter Turnout
source: Chicago municipal election results via DataMade / Chicago Board of Elections
description: Ballots cast as a share of registered voters.

label: Attendance
description: Alder attendance rate for the current Councilmatic session, combined by ward when representation changed.

label: Bills Sponsored
description: Non-routine bills sponsored by alders associated with the ward in the configured Councilmatic session.

label: Participatory budgeting
source: UIC Great Cities Institute; City Cast Chicago; ward sites
description: Whether the ward lets residents vote on its menu-money spending (participatory budgeting); at finer geographies, the share of the area governed by a PB ward.

label: Menu $ on active transport
source: Chicago CIP aldermanic menu PDFs (ward-wise/data-analysis pipeline)
description: Share of the ward's ~$1.5M menu money spent on bike/pedestrian/street-redesign projects (vs. the car-oriented default), latest full year — a clean signal of ward priorities.

label: Menu budget used
source: Chicago CIP aldermanic menu PDFs (ward-wise/data-analysis pipeline)
description: Share of the ward's ~$1.5M annual menu allotment actually committed to projects in the latest full year (high = capital deployed, low = left idle).

label: Menu project diversity
source: Chicago CIP aldermanic menu PDFs (ward-wise/data-analysis pipeline)
description: How varied the ward's menu spending is across project categories (1 − Herfindahl, 0–100). Descriptive — neither concentration nor variety is inherently better.

label: Menu spending spread
source: Chicago CIP aldermanic menu PDFs, geocoded (ward-wise/data-analysis pipeline)
description: How geographically dispersed menu spending is, adjusted for the ward's own size and shape (100 = as dispersed as a uniform ward, below 100 = concentrated). Descriptive.

label: Traffic injuries
source: Traffic Crashes (Chicago Police via city portal)
description: People injured in police-reported traffic crashes in the area each year.

label: Pedestrian & cyclist crashes
source: Traffic Crashes (Chicago Police via city portal)
description: Crashes where the first impact was with a person walking or biking.

label: Violent Crime
source: Chicago Data Portal crime records and ACS population estimates
description: Reported violent crimes per 10,000 residents. Violent follows the FBI's NIBRS standard — homicide, sexual assault, assault, battery — which classes robbery as a crime against property (the older UCR summary index counted robbery as violent).

label: Environmental Justice
description: Cumulative environmental burden and population vulnerability, from the city's Chicago Environmental Justice Index. Higher means greater burden.

label: Park Access
source: Chicago Park District parks data plus ACS population estimates
description: Chicago Park District acres available per 10,000 residents.

label: New Housing Permits
description: Likely residential new-construction building permits issued each year.

label: Housing Construction Investment
description: Reported construction cost of new residential building permits issued each year.

label: Renovation investment
description: Reported construction cost of residential renovation permits — reinvestment in existing housing.

label: New Homes Permitted (est.)
description: Estimated new dwelling units permitted each year.

label: Home Renovation Permits
description: Likely residential renovation and alteration permits issued each year.

label: Demolition Permits
description: Wrecking and demolition permits issued each year, all structure types.

label: Permit Processing Time
description: Days the city takes to issue building permits.

label: PM2.5
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Fine-particulate (PM2.5) air pollution, annual average µg/m³.

label: Ozone
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Ground-level ozone, summer seasonal average of the daily maximum 8-hour concentration (ppb).

label: Diesel PM
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Diesel particulate matter in air (µg/m³).

label: Air-toxics cancer risk
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Modeled lifetime cancer risk from air toxics, per million people.

label: Air-toxics hazard
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: The air-toxics respiratory hazard index (sum of hazard quotients).

label: Toxic releases
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: RSEI toxicity-weighted air concentration of Toxic Release Inventory chemicals.

label: Traffic proximity
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Traffic proximity and volume (annual daily traffic within 500 m ÷ distance).

label: Childhood lead
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Children ages 1–5 with a blood lead level at or above 5 µg/dL.

label: Freight-rail proximity
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Proximity-weighted freight rail lines.

label: TRI facility proximity
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Proximity-weighted Toxic Release Inventory facilities.

label: RMP site proximity
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Proximity-weighted Risk Management Plan sites.

label: Polluted-site proximity
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Proximity-weighted Superfund, Brownfield, and state-remediation sites.

label: Hazardous-waste proximity
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Proximity-weighted RCRA hazardous-waste facilities.

label: Wastewater proximity
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Proximity-weighted RSEI toxic concentrations at nearby stream segments.

label: Consequential-facility proximity
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: Proximity-weighted consequential (major-emitter) facilities.

label: Pollution burden
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: The pollution-burden component score (environmental exposures and conditions), 0–10.

label: Population vulnerability
description: Chicago EJ Index indicator: The population-characteristics component score (sensitive populations and socioeconomic factors), 0–10.

label: EJ impact rate
description: Share of an area's population living in an Environmental Justice priority neighborhood (an EJ-designated community area), derived from the Chicago EJ Index.

label: Water Fountain Lead
description: Share of Chicago Park District park fountain sites with any historically elevated lead result.

label: Chain restaurant share (Google Maps sweep)
source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps
description: Share of a place's restaurants that are chain outlets rather than independents.

label: Parking lots
description: Mapped off-street parking lots and garages per square km (does not include street parking).

label: Parking Complaints
description: Abandoned-vehicle and bike-lane parking 311 complaints per square km (since 2023).

label: Parking Difficulty
description: How contested parking is, proxied by parking complaints' share of all local 311 activity.

label: Cars per Household
description: Average vehicles available per household (parking demand).

label: Permit-Zone Density
description: Residential permit-zone block faces per square km (parking scarcity signal).

label: Sun Access
description: Share of daylight that ground-level spots receive direct sun, averaged over the year.

label: Summer Sun
description: Ground-level direct-sun share on the summer solstice (June 21).

label: Winter Sun
description: Ground-level direct-sun share on the winter solstice (December 21), when shadows are longest.

label: Metrics Submitted
description: Resident metric ideas submitted to Ward Wise Explorer from the ward.

label: Absentee-owned homes
description: Share of residential parcels whose taxpayer mailing address differs from the property address — a proxy for absentee/landlord ownership over owner-occupancy.

label: Happiness (modeled)
description: A modeled estimate of subjective happiness (0–100) given the area's circumstantial composition — income, marital/household status, employment, home ownership, and health. Not an observed local survey.

label: Very happy % (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to report being 'very happy' given the area's circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

label: Religious attendance (modeled)
description: A modeled estimate of religious-service attendance (0–100) given the area's demographic and circumstantial composition. Not an observed local survey or a count of congregations.

label: Weekly attenders % (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to attend religious services nearly weekly or more, given the area's demographic and circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

label: No religious affiliation % (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to report no religious affiliation, given the area's demographic and circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

label: Certain God exists % (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to say they know God exists with no doubts, given the area's demographic and circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

label: Strongly religious % (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to call their religious affiliation strong, given the area's demographic and circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

label: Life feels exciting % (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to describe their life as exciting (vs routine or dull), given the area's circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

label: Satisfied with finances % (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to report being satisfied with their present financial situation, given the area's circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

label: Social trust (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to say most people can be trusted, given the area's circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not an observed survey.

label: Fear of walking at night (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to report being afraid to walk alone at night near home — a perceived-safety estimate, not a crime statistic or local survey.

label: Sees friends weekly % (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to spend an evening with friends weekly or more, given the area's circumstantial composition and density. Synthetic estimate.

label: Socializes with neighbors weekly % (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to spend an evening with neighbors weekly or more, given the area's circumstantial composition and density. Synthetic estimate.

label: At a bar weekly % (modeled)
description: Modeled share of adults expected to visit a bar or tavern weekly or more. The most caveated of the modeled socializing metrics — mostly a density gradient.

label: Daily leisure time (modeled)
source: American Time Use Survey, small-area estimated
description: Modeled average minutes of daily leisure — socializing, relaxing, TV, sports and exercise — expected given the area's circumstantial composition. A synthetic estimate, not a local time-diary survey.

label: Time poverty (modeled)
source: American Time Use Survey, small-area estimated
description: Modeled share of adults expected to get under two hours of daily leisure — the time-poor. A synthetic estimate, not a local survey.

label: Landlord profit (assessed)
description: Estimated share of rent that ends up as landlord profit, using each rental parcel's assessed market value as the mortgage basis.

label: Landlord profit (sale price)
description: Same estimate, but the mortgage basis is the parcel's last arm's-length sale price — models likely real debt, but reads thin/negative for recent buyers.

description: Gathering places — cafés, bars, restaurants, gyms, bookstores — per 10,000 residents.

label: Trade & Vocational Schools

description: Water-in-basement and water-on-street 311 requests per 10,000 residents.

label: Basement Flooding
description: Water-in-basement 311 requests per 10,000 residents.

label: Street Flooding
description: Water-on-street 311 requests per 10,000 residents.

label: Sewer Cleaning
description: Sewer cleaning inspection requests per 10,000 residents.

label: Sewer Cave-Ins
description: Sewer cave-in inspection requests per 10,000 residents.

label: Summer Surface Temperature
source: USGS Landsat via Microsoft Planetary Computer
description: Typical summer late-morning ground and roof temperature from Landsat, not air temperature (°C).

label: Hottest Surfaces
source: USGS Landsat via Microsoft Planetary Computer
description: What the area's hottest 5% of ground and roofs reach in a typical summer late morning, not air temperature (°C).

label: Hot Pavement Share
source: USGS Landsat via Microsoft Planetary Computer
description: Share of the area that is hot pavement or roof, 38°C (100°F) or more at the surface, in a typical summer late morning.

label: Citizen Air Sensors
description: PurpleAir sensors per 10,000 residents: households publishing their own air and temperature readings.

label: Summer Night Air Temperature
description: Typical 2–5 am summer air temperature (°C), smoothed from citizen sensors and airport stations.

label: Summer Afternoon Sensor Temperature
description: Typical noon–3 pm summer reading from citizen sensors (°C). Sun-exposed housings run hot; read as a heat-exposure signal, not air temperature.

label: Summer Night Humidity
description: Typical 2–5 am summer relative humidity (%), smoothed from citizen sensors and airport stations.

label: Fine Particles (citizen sensors)
description: Annual mean PM2.5 (µg/m³) from citizen sensors with the EPA correction, smoothed to the area.

label: Gyms & fitness (Google Maps sweep)
source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps
description: Gyms, studios, martial arts, and pools per 10,000 residents.

label: Mental Health Providers
source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps
description: Google-visible therapists, psychologists, psychiatrists, and clinics per 10,000 residents.

label: Worship Rating
source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps
description: Median Google rating of the area's houses of worship.

label: Beloved Congregations
source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps
description: Worship places rated 4.8+ with 25+ reviews.

label: Worship Engagement
source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps
description: Google reviews of worship places per 10,000 residents.

label: Faith Diversity
source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps
description: Variety of religious traditions among the area's houses of worship.

label: Open Late
source: Google Maps via Apify third-places sweeps
description: Gathering places open at 9pm on weekdays, per 10,000 residents.
